text: Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens with valid passports. applicants who have emigrated abroad and acquired foreign nationality must hold a valid foreign passport or nationality certificate for 4 years or more (before April 30th, 2023), and have more than 2 years of residence in foreign countries during this period (The actual residence in a foreign country for more than 9 months in a year can be calculated as one year, subject to the entry and exit stamps).Applicants should be in good health both mentally and physically and without infectious diseases according to The Exit and Entry Administration Law of the People's Republic of China and relevant regulations of JZMU.Applicants with non-criminal records.Applicants with a financial guarantee.Applicants must be holders of a high school diploma or above with good academic records.Applicants should be between 18 and 30 years old.Applicants for Chinese-taught programs must have the certificate of HSK level 4; applicants without the certificate of HSK level 4 must pass the Chinese language proficiency test organized by JZMU.
